boundaries: All promoted statements are exact finite group, projector, perturbative effective-Hamiltonian, Bloch-band, overlap-operator, subgroup-commutant, resolvent, information-thermodynamic, or short-time propagator results.

No fabricated mobile-pair device, measured pump, chiral Standard Model, physical non-Abelian gauge boson, inverse-scattering experiment, thermodynamic measurement, gravity, cosmology, or theory of everything is claimed.

pass4081_canonical_dark_irreps.boundary: The ATLAS class map, character fingerprints, multiplicities, and central idempotents are exact. Galois-pair a/b suffix orientation is left canonical unless independently fixed by an official representation trace.
pass4081_canonical_dark_irreps.canonical_orientation: For unresolved Galois/table-automorphism suffix pairs, plus/minus is fixed by the sign of the imaginary part on the first ATLAS class where the pair differs; no suffix is guessed.
pass4081_canonical_dark_irreps.central_idempotent: e_chi=(degree/25920) sum_C conjugate(chi(C)) K_C; the listed exact fingerprints determine every coefficient.
pass4081_canonical_dark_irreps.character_field: Every fingerprint entry [p,q] denotes (p + q i sqrt(3))/2 in the exact ATLAS class order.
pass4081_canonical_dark_irreps.dark_projector: P_dark,chi is the action of e_chi on Sym^2(H1) minus the 160-dimensional incidence-edge bright module.
pass4081_canonical_dark_irreps.group: PSp(4,3) = U4(2), generated explicitly by four projective symplectic transvections

pass4082_mobile_composite_pairs.boundary: Mobility requires the explicit pair-binding offset Delta. The bare repulsive contact-dark manifold alone is neither bound nor mobile.
pass4082_mobile_composite_pairs.irrep_action: Symmetry-preserving hopping is identity on every one of the 19 dark isotypic sectors, so sectors do not mix and share the clean dispersion.
pass4082_mobile_composite_pairs.model: A ring of cells with a -Delta energy for same-cell contact-dark pairs and single-photon nearest-neighbour hopping t that preserves the H1 internal mode.

pass4083_two_parameter_pair_pump.bloch_hamiltonian: h=(J1+J2 cos k) sigma_x + J2 sin k sigma_y + m sigma_z
pass4083_two_parameter_pair_pump.boundary: Exact clean filled-band Rice-Mele/Thouless pump for the effective pair center. Disorder, interactions between pairs, finite filling preparation, loss, and measured quantization remain open.

pass4084_overlap_fermions.anomaly_boundary: Eighty-one identical vectorlike copies do not automatically make an anomaly-free Weyl theory. Chiral gauge content and anomaly cancellation remain unconstructed.
pass4084_overlap_fermions.corner_audit: One light external species survives; fifteen Wilson corners are heavy.
pass4084_overlap_fermions.domain_wall_limit: Finite fifth dimension approximates sign(H_W) exponentially; exact overlap is the infinite/explicit-sign limit.
pass4084_overlap_fermions.ginsparg_wilson: gamma5 D + D gamma5 = a D gamma5 D
pass4084_overlap_fermions.modified_chirality: hat_gamma5=gamma5(1-aD), with exact lattice chiral projectors.
pass4084_overlap_fermions.wilson_kernel: H_W(k)=gamma5[D_W(k)-m0], with D_W=i sum gamma_mu sin k_mu + r sum(1-cos k_mu)

pass4085_one_marked_edge_nonabelian_comm.boundary: This is a symmetry-commutant control algebra, not an identification of physical QCD or electroweak gauge bosons. Coupling selection and dynamical gauge fields remain open.
pass4085_one_marked_edge_nonabelian_comm.largest_block: A six-dimensional stabilizer irrep occurs with multiplicity 3, producing U(3) and hence an exact SU(3) subalgebra.
pass4085_one_marked_edge_nonabelian_comm.minimality: Zero marked edges leaves only scalar U(1); one marked edge already yields U(3), so one is minimal in number of marked incidence edges.
pass4085_one_marked_edge_nonabelian_comm.su2_blocks: Several three-dimensional stabilizer irreps occur with multiplicity 2, producing exact U(2) and SU(2) subalgebras.
pass4085_one_marked_edge_nonabelian_comm.unmarked_commutant: H1 is irreducible under PSp(4,3), so the full-symmetry commutant is scalar U(1).

pass4086_single_port_inverse_spectrum.boundary: Ideal noiseless rational inverse scattering. Finite-window conditioning, parasitics, and laboratory system identification remain open.
pass4086_single_port_inverse_spectrum.inverse_statement: One ideal vertex port recovers all five Levi Laplacian eigenvalues and multiplicities from poles and residues because the graph is vertex-transitive.
pass4086_single_port_inverse_spectrum.shell_extension: Combining the port with the four exact differential shell transfer functions recovers graph distance 1,2,3,4.

pass4087_landauer_dark_reservoir.boundary: Reversible information-thermodynamic lower bounds only; no calorimetric experiment or finite-time erasure protocol is certified.
pass4087_landauer_dark_reservoir.no_free_lunch: Erasing the retained label record costs at least the same kBT H(label), restoring the full Landauer cost.

pass4088_operational_causal_metric.boundary: An operational causal metric on a finite hopping graph, not an emergent Lorentzian spacetime or gravity theory.
pass4088_operational_causal_metric.exact_metric: d(u,v) equals line-graph distance because (A^n)_uv=0 below the shortest-path length.
pass4088_operational_causal_metric.hamiltonian: H=J A_line on the 160 incidence-link sites
pass4088_operational_causal_metric.reading: Short-time response order reconstructs distance; the coefficient reconstructs shortest-path degeneracy.
